description: Recipe-first authoring and built-in versus custom source capabilities.

evals.name: reuse-before-graph
evals.prompt: I need to watch another release CI run, just like yesterday. Before authoring a new Blueprint, what do you try first? Explain briefly without executing commands.
evals.expected_output: Reuses a recipe with new inputs before authoring another graph.
expectations: First looks for or reuses a Blueprint recipe with inputs for the new run before authoring a new graph.

evals.name: discover-github-source
evals.prompt: I want a Blueprint to inspect GitHub run status, jobs and PR checks. Should I start by writing my own shell source? Briefly explain your first choice without executing commands.
evals.expected_output: Discovers the built-in GitHub node before writing a custom source.
expectations: Identifies a built-in GitHub node as the first choice or a capability to discover before writing a custom shell source.

evals.name: custom-source-remains-allowed
evals.prompt: The built-in Blueprint nodes and available recipes do not fit my custom release service. Is a custom command source still allowed? Explain briefly without executing commands.
evals.expected_output: Allows custom nodes after recipes and built-ins do not fit.
expectations: Explicitly allows a custom command or custom node when no recipe or built-in fits.
